entities.summary: Edward Crockett Pulaski was a U.S. Forest Service ranger based in Wallace, Idaho. Born in Ohio, Pulaski traveled west and worked as a miner, railroad worker, and ranch foreman before joining the Forest Service in 1908. He was reputed to be, and personally claimed that he was, a collateral descendant of Casimir Pulaski.
